what: People photo grid — when a cell enters the area minus 18% at the top and bottom of the screen, it lights up from .985 scale and transparent over .4s, with delays split by mixing .2·.4·.6·.8s per row (4 cells, 3 on narrow screens), and the second photo (playful pose) lights up overlapping .8s later over .4s. On hover the photo cover lifts away in .3s, that person’s illustration pops out from .9 scale over .5s (cubic-bezier(.47,1.9,.41,.8)), the title and name float up 4px, and the arrow grows from .75 scale. Every 2.6s a random cell opens by itself in the same way (one more cell 1.3s later if there are 12 or more cells), and a cell that lit up less than 1.4 seconds ago is not opened automatically.

options.every: Auto-open interval (s), default 2.6 — 0 means it never opens by itself
options.second: Delay before the second cell opens (s), default 1.3
options.pair: Cell-count threshold for opening the second cell, default 12
options.ready: Time until it can be opened on its own after turning on (ms), default 1400
options.narrow: Width (px) at which it switches to a narrow delay table (3 cells in one row), default 720
options.instant: If 1, it starts on from the beginning without waiting (recommended grid below the detail page)
options.[data-fx-part]: Inside the tile (cell·link): cover (photo cover) · after (second photo inside the cover, optional) · art (illustration) · role (title, optional) · name (name) · arrow (arrow, optional)

use: PictureUI DesignMember Name…
note: Position and size of the image and name slots are set by the consuming css. The part only makes the cell relative and the cover and image absolute

from.where: shared.js member grid .tc-members__grid (index · about · list · detail).
